caption:
हॉलीवुड के बॉक्स ऑफिस पर मची है तबाही, क्या क्लेफेस कर पाएगी बड़ा धमाका?

जेम्स वॉटकिंस की फिल्म क्लेफेस ने बॉक्स ऑफिस पर अपनी पकड़ मजबूत बना ली है।
फिल्म ने अपने तीसरे शुक्रवार को 2 मिलियन डॉलर की कमाई की है।
इसका डोमेस्टिक कलेक्शन अब 52 मिलियन डॉलर के पार पहुँच चुका है।
फिल्म ने वंडर वुमन 1984 और कैटवूमन जैसी बड़ी फिल्मों को पीछे छोड़ दिया है।
अब यह फिल्म द सुसाइड स्क्वाड के 55.6 मिलियन डॉलर के आंकड़े से बस 5 मिलियन डॉलर दूर है।
फिल्म 23 अक्टूबर को रिलीज हुई थी और अब टॉप 40 हाईएस्ट-ग्रॉसिंग डीसी फिल्मों में शामिल हो गई है। 🎬🔥

क्या आपको लगता है कि क्लेफेस जल्द ही द सुसाइड स्क्वाड का रिकॉर्ड तोड़ देगी? कमेंट्स में बताएं! 👇🍿

ctx.text:
Clayface has been hit by the wave of newcomers at the North American box office. However, the film still holds strong domestically and is outperforming major DC movies. The body-horror movie has surpassed Wonder Woman 1984 and is now on track to surpass James Gunn’s DC movie, The Suicide Squad, at the North American box office. Keep scrolling for more.
The DCU horror flick has collected a solid $2 million at the North American box office on its 3rd Friday. It dropped by 38.8% domestically from last Friday, despite losing 532 theaters on Thursday. It is more than Other Mommy’s $1.2 million and Birds of Prey’s $1.9 million 3rd Friday collections. The film’s domestic total has crossed $50 million , now standing at $52 million .
According to Box Office Mojo ‘s data, Clayface has surpassed the domestic hauls of Wonder Woman 2 and Catwoman to climb the box office chart among DC movies in North America. It has entered the all-time top 40 highest-grossing DC movies at the domestic box office.
It is now on track to beat the domestic haul of The Suicide Squad. For the record, it was released in 2021 and features an ensemble cast including Margot Robbie and Idris Elba. The James Gunn -helmed The Suicide Squad has grossed $55.6 million domestically. Clayface is less than $5 million away from surpassing The Suicide Squad and climbing the box office chart for DC movies in North America.
The film follows a rising Hollywood star whose life takes a horrifying turn, transforming him into a revenge-filled monster. Exploring themes of lost identity and humanity, corrosive love, and unchecked scientific ambition, Clayface delves into one man’s terrifying descent into darkness. Directed by James Watkins, Clayface was released in theaters on October 23.
